remarks: Beautifully maintained ranch in the heart of Westport! Sunlight illuminates the front living room and opens up to a dining area. The kitchen features new stainless steel appliances and easy access to laundry, garage and deck. Three bedrooms with ample closet space and a spacious full bathroom complete the main floor. Additional storage in the unfinished lower level. Gorgeous yard! Minutes form downtown shops, restaurants, schools, train, beaches and highways!
